reviewer: game_poo_full direct visual self review; independent acceptance pending

face.observation: Red faceted curved flame helmet with exposed-silver ridge surrounds brushed silver face, low half-lidded eyes and tiny horizontal mouth.

silhouette.observation: Full red segmented torso, bracers, thighs, shins and angular boots create a wide stable stance; distinct from 590Y silver lower body.

emblem.observation: Circular chest badge has vertically divided dark oxide / polished silver fields and center silver droplet; no GA hexagon or CR roll symbol.

material.observation: Red/silver exposed plate pattern retains original 780Y full-body identity; surface texture is material treatment, without heat-state glow, battle effects or new rarity claims.

thumbnail72.observation: Actual 72px keeps red flame helmet and fully red legs distinct from 590Y; face, red segmented silhouette and circular silver badge remain visible.
